scenes.title: Meet DUMB
scenes.headline: Your media tools, together
scenes.description: Set up and manage the applications that find, organize and play your media.
caption: DUMB brings your media tools into one dashboard.
Choose the applications and workflow you need.

scenes.title: How the pieces work together
scenes.headline: From a request to playback

steps.title: Find or request
steps.detail: Search directly or use an optional request app.

steps.title: Prepare the library
steps.detail: Your selected workflow handles the item and its library path.

steps.title: Watch or listen
steps.detail: A media server reads the configured library.

scenes.note: You provide the accounts, provider access and library choices.
caption: Start with one workflow and one media server.
DUMB manages the apps; you choose how your library works.

scenes.title: Install on the host you use
scenes.headline: Choose your deployment guide

steps.title: Pick your host
steps.detail: Docker, a NAS, Windows with WSL2, or native Proxmox LXC.

steps.title: Keep your data
steps.detail: Prepare persistent folders and the required access.

steps.title: Open DUMB
steps.detail: Follow first-run setup in the dashboard.

caption: Use the deployment guide for your platform.
Keep configuration and application data in persistent storage.

scenes.title: See your selected services
caption: The dashboard shows the services in your DUMB installation.
Open a service to review its status and controls.

scenes.title: Work with one application
caption: A service page brings its controls, settings and logs together.
Use the embedded application to finish its own setup.

scenes.title: Read and filter service logs
caption: Logs show what the selected service is doing.
Filter messages by name or level to focus on the problem.

scenes.title: Check an update before installing
caption: Open Tools → Updates and check for an available version.
Review the result before choosing to install; this example only checks.

scenes.title: Make the dashboard comfortable
caption: Use appearance settings to choose a comfortable dashboard view.
These preferences change how the frontend is displayed.

scenes.title: Check resource use
caption: Metrics help you review resource use and spot pressure.
Use the charts alongside the affected service's logs.

scenes.title: Try one complete workflow
scenes.headline: Make the first test a small one

steps.title: Install DUMB
steps.detail: Follow the guide for your host.

steps.title: Set up your apps
steps.detail: Add the accounts, providers and library paths they need.

steps.title: Test one item
steps.detail: Check an import and playback before adding more services.

caption: Follow the deployment guide, then complete first-run setup.
Test one import and playback before expanding your stack.
